description: Ministry of Health - Request for publishing the Medical Ordinance (Procedure for Election of Members) Regulation
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Medical Ordinance, establishing procedures for electing members to the Sri Lanka Medical Council. It creates a legal/regulatory framework for election processes within a professional body, which falls under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (new regulations, statutory instruments, and regulatory frameworks). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, and the election process described is for a professional council rather than a governmental electoral process.
